content: अमनस्, -अमनस्क {%a.%} .²1 Without the organ of desire, thought <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 Devoid of intellect (as a child). .²3 Inattentive, careless. .²4 Having no control over the mind. .²5 Devoid of affection. {%n.%} ({@-नः@}) .²1 Not the organ of desire, non-perception. .²2 Inattention. {%m.%} The Supreme Being.
